About

Environmental Consultant

Environmental professional with a multidisciplinary background in environmental consultancy, environmental management, compliance, auditing, and HSE, developed through work on oil & gas, energy, industrial, infrastructure, construction, and recycling projects across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). This combination of consultancy and hands-on project experience has built a practical understanding of environmental requirements from both technical and implementation perspectives, covering EIA/ESIA, HSEIA, environmental screening and scoping, baseline studies, impact and risk assessment, permitting, compliance, auditing, environmental management planning, monitoring, and technical reporting.

Alongside assessment and reporting, the work has involved reviewing project and environmental data, interpreting regulatory requirements, identifying technical and compliance gaps, evaluating potential impacts and risks, and developing mitigation and management measures appropriate to project conditions. This experience has been shaped by work under national environmental requirements and internationally recognised frameworks, including the IFC Performance Standards, World Bank Group EHS Guidelines, and ISO 14001, as well as project-specific and lender E&S requirements.

This background brings together field experience, environmental assessment, regulatory knowledge, and technical review, with a practical approach to developing clear, evidence-based, and technically robust environmental documentation.
